verdict.rationale: WinPwnage was run to elevate privileges via a WMI event subscription: WMIC created a CommandLineEventConsumer, an __EventFilter and a binding (Sysmon 19/20/21), after which WmiPrvSE spawned cmd.exe as SYSTEM. The same python process also opened winlogon and lsass handles, and the WMI objects were then deleted to cover tracks.
